title: Research Spectrum Icons
summary: A balanced semantic icon palette that separates source, proofs, data, tables, manuscripts, and research assets at a glance.
details: Research Spectrum is the general-purpose TheoX file icon theme. Its compact symbols and distinct but restrained colors make mixed research workspaces easier to scan without competing with the editor or the selected workbench theme.
features: Semantic colors for source, formal, data, manuscript, and asset files
Compact symbols designed for dense Study explorers
Balanced contrast across dark and light workbench themes
